title: Reggular
description: Tired of the new eggs not stacking? This datapack is just for you.
body:
Reggular makes warm and cold variants of chickens lay regular eggs to help with inventory management. No bundles needed!
### Note:
When Reggular is installed in existing worlds, all chickens will lay regular eggs, but brown and blue eggs from before will still exist. To fix this(version beta 0.0.3 and onwards only), Simply place any amount of brown eggs or blue eggs in the crafting grid.

How to convert brown/blue eggs to regular eggs:
![The crafting recipe for converting eggs.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d88fe0d69856fdadf2c1fb716c0e94a3bfa26af.gif)
